method: Known revisions: independent source/option re-derivation before reopening current keyed versions, not a blind review.

records.reasoning: Literal arrows give System→Model→Simulation→Analysis and visualization. Equal stage sequences now assessed as easy.
The absent coherent contrast is deterministic/stochastic. All other pairs are explicitly listed; revised NOT question no longer reveals key via mismatched taxonomy.
Changing conditions=flexibility; avoiding prototypes=cost; hazardous failures=safety; many quick experiments=speed. Four parallel permutations and bounded assumption close the omitted speed angle.

Uncertain model calls for probability/statistics; optimization objective calls for optimization. Other pairs reverse roles or mistake software checking/one nominal run for model uncertainty analysis. Direct association is easy.
All three source limits are omitted real effects, accumulated errors and simplified environment. Each alternate now changes one source property within the same three-part list.

Computational modelling evaluates equations repeatedly with varying parameters. Merely storing observations, requiring closed forms or inferring all physical parameters are distinct incorrect workflows.

Dynamic numerical study uses vector/matrix representation, approximations and repeated calculations over time. Static/steady-state substitution and mandatory closed forms do not answer the stipulated dynamic problem.
The actual blue arrow identifies carrier board with I/O ports, not the compute module or fan. Easy direct picture label.

Kit is development/test hardware platform; JetPack is supporting software. Revised alternatives confuse hardware/software or shrink kit to carrier board, but no longer rely on replacing every sensor/cloud-only claims.
With no active environment, activate vrenv before pip install, then deactivate. Installing before/after activation targets outside vrenv under stated pip assumption; uninstall is the wrong operation.
Different literal directory names cause the specified cd target not to exist. Underscores are allowed; cd does not rename or alias distinct names. Direct mismatch easy.

Source classification interpreted/high-level plus editor preparation and interpreter execution, named .py/.ipynb. Parallel alternatives each corrupt one component. Assumptions correctly avoid bytecode prohibition and script/notebook equivalence; gap closed.
Direct source-card association integrate: ODE integration solve_ivp/odeint. Other module names are parallel plausible library confusions; easy classification now appropriate.
Direct source-card association optimize: minimization, roots and least squares. Other module names are parallel plausible library confusions; easy classification now appropriate.
Direct source-card association signal: Butterworth filtering and spectra. Other module names are parallel plausible library confusions; easy classification now appropriate.
Direct source-card association spatial: KD-tree, convex hull and rotation interpolation. Other module names are parallel plausible library confusions; easy classification now appropriate.
Direct source-card association linalg: Riccati equation advanced linear algebra. Other module names are parallel plausible library confusions; easy classification now appropriate.
Direct source-card association stats: distributions and hypothesis testing. Other module names are parallel plausible library confusions; easy classification now appropriate.
Explicitly repaired function call returns10*5=50; m/s times s gives metres, not m/s. Easy single multiplication, with original undefined-name conflict retained as source note.
sqrt441=21.0 as a floating principal square root. Wrong values are division, square or unchangedargument; direct easy computation.
status prints Robot: rover_1 then Speed: 1.5. It does not print move output or swap fields. Source literal print trace is easy.
path=[pose] creates a one-element list containing the initial position before motion accumulation. It is not goal-only, transform conversion or per-motion preallocation. Easy direct list semantics.
Visible endpoint blue(4,3), separate red(5,4), axes position. Code four motion rows sum(4,3), corroborating plot. Easy direct diagram interpretation.

Interpret simulation, debug/test algorithms and prepare real-hardware transition. Alternatives now contrast actual but inadequate workflows: hardware-first/report-only simulation, import-only check or one-trajectory complete validation. Source144/168 supports rejecting substitution for physical validation.

sourceObservations.observation: Four directed pictures: System→Model→Simulation→Analysis and visualization. Velocity-time trapezoid in last icon has no numeric ticks; question asks only stage ordering.

Three listed study comparisons actual/model, physical/mathematical, analytic/simulation. Deterministic/stochastic is a coherent different contrast, not listed here; source scope avoids denying its validity generally.

Four advantages: cost avoids repeated prototypes; safety avoids risky damage; speed allows many quick experiments; flexibility changes parameters/conditions. Not universal speed superiority or time compression.
Extra context viewed: Model→Code→Execute then next-page Analyze. Execute produces performance data; not evidence for statistical analysis itself.

Analyze uses probability/statistics for model uncertainty and optimization techniques for optimization goal. Cycle diagram Model→Code→Execute→Analyse→Model, stopping by sufficient system-performance match.

Simulation uses discrete updates over time from current state and inputs, with initial conditions. High sensitivity is a source overgeneralization, not adopted by revised numerical-computation question.

Verification implementation matches conceptual model/specs; validation matches reality for intended use. Slope example supports real-test requirement; logical proofs alone not evidence of physical match.
Omitted physical effects, accumulated numerical errors, simpler environment; decision support not perfect real-testing replacement.
Python represents/evaluates equations numerically, changes parameters and studies behavior; does not require analytic closed form or infer all parameters from equation syntax.
Vectors/matrices, approximate complex-equation solutions and repeated calculations over time. Dynamic evolution not replaced by fixed initial/steady state solution.

Photo label carrier board with I/O ports separate from module below heat sink and fan. Kit develops/tests edge AI; JetPack SDK is software for sensor processing and robotics functions, source-time scoped.

Visible activation→pip install rvc3python→deactivate. Existing-environment question avoids creation/package-install API claims. mkdir first_project then cd my_project mismatch remains explicit; incomplete sudo apt line not endorsed.

Python called interpreted high-level, supports multiple paradigms, dynamic types and garbage collection; source lists .py/.ipynb and code editor/interpreter separately. Revision preserves script/notebook distinction and avoids denying implementation compilation.

Six module cards: integrate ODE solvers; optimize minimization/root/least squares; signal filtering/spectra; spatial KD-tree/hull/Slerp; linalg Riccati/LQR; stats distributions/tests. Current questions are source-scoped category associations, not API invocation. Kalman/PDE broad wording remains ledger issue.
Function compute_distance returns speed*time, but screenshot calls compute_travel_distance; revised question explicitly changes call to correct defined name with10,5, yielding50 metres.
math.sqrt(441) visible. Principal square root21.0, not division or squaring. Right-side sensor loop not used by targeted item.
Robot stores name,speed; status prints Robot: name and Speed: speed on separate lines. robot1=Robot(rover_1,1.5). move(4) is separate following call; do not conflate its output with status.

pose=[0,0],goal=[5,4],four motion rows(1,1),(1,.5),(1,.5),(1,1); path=[pose] stores initial array as one list element. No preallocation or4x4 conversion; later rebinding avoids same-array overwrite in shown original.
Actual plot blue connected circles(0,0),(1,1),(2,1.5),(3,2),(4,3), red goal(5,4). X and Y position axes, not time. Code updates by rebinding pose and appends, plots o- and red scatter.

Programming foundation supports simulation, testing before real deployment, AI packages, interpreting ROS simulation and logical debugging. It prepares transition, does not replace validation with imports or report figures.

Eight summary rows include modelling/control/physics/RL roles and sim-to-real parameter identification/domain randomisation/physical validation. Broad90%, any dynamic system,5–10lines and universal support claims retained as caveats, not adopted.
Summary repeats simplified models, time behavior, reduced risk/cost/time, flexible repeatability and packages; supports computational-model role without new algorithm.
